candidates.cp_b_title_en: Data types loaded into compliance systems

cp_a.title_zh: 国家身份数据库与电子了解你的客户及蜜罐风险
cp_a.title_en: National Identity Databases for eKYC and Honeypot Risk
cp_a.reason: Units 4058-4062 discuss national identity databases as an enhancement to eKYC, along with the associated honeypot risk, useful as a review point on a relevant example and its drawback.

units.zh: 印度、新加坡、香港等许多国家/地区通过实施国家身份数据库简化了e了解你的客户流程。
units.en: Many countries such as India, Singapore, and Hong Kong have streamlined eKYC processes even more by implementing national identity databases.

units.zh: 政府使用集中式系统存储和管理公民的个人身份信息（PII）。
units.en: Governments use these centralized systems to store and manage the personally identifiable information (PII) of their citizens.

units.zh: 国家身份数据库通常包含姓名、地址、出生日期、生物识别信息和唯一识别号。
units.en: These databases typically include data such as names, addresses, dates of birth, biometric information, and unique identification numbers.

units.zh: 金融机构连接数据库以实现更顺畅安全的客户准入
units.en: Financial institutions are linked to these databases, ensuring a smoother and more secure onboarding process.

units.zh: 集中式国民身份数据库存在蜜罐问题和网络攻击风险
units.en: One issue with national identity databases is that they can create “honeypot” problems for governments. Centralized databases that curate valuable information are regular targets for cyberattacks.

cp_b.title_zh: 录入合规系统的数据类型
cp_b.title_en: Data types loaded into compliance systems
cp_b.reason: Units 4772–4776 together define the various data inputs (customer details, attributes, activity, external information) that can be loaded into compliance systems, forming a core review point on data types.

units.zh: 有效合规系统需要高质量数据，数据可包括客户详情、属性、活动等。
units.en: Effective compliance systems require high-quality data. Data loaded into compliance systems can include:

units.zh: 客户详情，如姓名和地址。
units.en: Customer details, such as name and address.

units.zh: 属性，如业务类型和账户类型。
units.en: Attributes, such as type of business and type of accounts held.

units.zh: 客户活动，如交易发送接收及涉及方。
units.en: Customer activity, such as what transactions are sent and received and who else is involved.

units.zh: 合规专家可获取外部信息，如已知罪犯名单、负面媒体报道等。
units.en: Compliance specialists may also decide to source external information such as lists of known criminals and terrorists, adverse media reports, and other useful material to help systems better detect risk within their customer or transactional base.

cp_a.reason: Defines entity resolution and explains its purpose and benefits.

units.zh: 实体解析是确认多条记录是否指向同一数据项的过程。
units.en: Entity resolution is the process of confirming whether multiple records are referring to the same data item.

units.zh: 合规系统使用实体解析准确识别跨数据集的个人和组织。
units.en: Organizations use entity resolution in compliance systems to accurately identify individuals, organizations, and other entities across different datasets.

units.zh: 实体解析通过整合多源信息创建客户单一视图，提升金融犯罪检测能力。
units.en: It improves financial crime detection by consolidating and linking entity-related information from various sources to create a single view of the customer.

units.zh: 实体解析为身份和预期活动带来更高精确度和确定性。
units.en: This adds greater precision and, therefore, greater certainty to the identity and expected activities of customers and related parties.

cp_b.title_zh: 采用智能交易监控解决方案
cp_b.reason: Units 3256–3257 describe the trend of adopting technology solutions and provide an example of intelligent contextual analysis, forming a coherent review point on solution adoption.

units.zh: 机构积极寻求和实施能生成更有用警报的解决方案，以减少误报并持续改进风险管理。
units.en: Organizations are actively seeking and implementing solutions that generate more useful alerts that reduce wasteful efforts caused by false positives. They continuously improve their ability to manage financial crime risk by assigning resources to mitigate genuine threats to the business.

units.zh: 智能上下文分析基于二元规则检查交易是否超过阈值并满足额外条件，如行为变化或行业风险。
units.en: For example, intelligent contextual analysis operates on a binary rule to check if a transaction exceeds a threshold and meets additional criteria. These criteria might include changes from a customer’s past behavior compared to their history and their peers, or if the customer is transacting in a higher-risk industry sector.

candidates.cp_b_title_en: Transforming Collected Data into Actionable Intelligence

cp_a.title_zh: 结构化与非结构化数据
cp_a.reason: This core_point contrasts the structured nature of internal data with the often unstructured nature of external data, defines unstructured data, and notes the processing required, providing a unified review concept.

units.zh: 内部数据通常是结构化格式，易于组织控制
units.en: Internal data is often in a structured format, which makes it easier for the organization to control.

units.zh: 非结构化数据定义：非固定格式的数据，如注释字段中的自由文本
units.en: Unstructured data is data that is not provided in a fixed format, such as free text that appears in a comment field.

units.zh: 外部数据来源多样，可能非结构化或与合规系统不兼容
units.en: External data originates from many diverse sources, which might make it unstructured or incompatible with compliance systems.

units.zh: 非结构化数据需要额外处理才能转换为可用格式
units.en: This requires additional work to refine it into a usable format.

cp_b.title_zh: 将收集的数据转化为可操作情报
cp_b.title_en: Transforming Collected Data into Actionable Intelligence
cp_b.reason: Covers the core shift from data collection to analysis and intelligence generation: units 3397-3398 define the rule and outcome, supported by the context of data collection in 3396.

units.zh: 调查员需分析数据以转化为可操作情报
units.en: However, investigators must go beyond merely gathering and recording this information. They analyze the data to transform it into actionable intelligence and insights.

units.zh: 通过审查交易历史、客户资料和监管警报验证可疑点
units.en: By examining transaction histories, customer profiles, and regulatory alerts, analysts can validate suspicions and decide if further investigation, reporting, or action is warranted.

units.zh: 交易监控和反洗钱调查中收集内外部数据
units.en: Throughout the transaction monitoring alert review and AML investigation processes, analysts and investigators collect and document data from internal and external sources.

candidates.cp_a_title_en: Free-trade zones: risks and criminal exploitation

cp_a.title_zh: 自由贸易区的风险与犯罪利用
cp_a.title_en: Free-trade zones: risks and criminal exploitation
cp_a.reason: Human review accepted this non-contiguous grouping because it forms one useful review topic in the section.

units.zh: 自由贸易区（FTZ）是境内关外的指定区域，货物入区免关税。
units.en: A free-trade zone (FTZ) is a designated area within a country treated as outside its customs territory, allowing businesses to import, store, handle, manufacture, and distribute goods without incurring customs duties until those goods enter the domestic market.

units.zh: 自由贸易区的商业友好特征吸引犯罪分子利用
units.en: However, their business-friendly features attract criminals to exploit them.

units.zh: 欧盟指出自由贸易区腐败、逃税、欺诈和制裁规避高发
units.en: The EU has commented that FTZs have a high incidence of corruption, tax evasion, and other criminal activities, such as fraud and sanctions evasion.

units.zh: 自由贸易区通过伪造文件进口再出口货物，便利贸易洗钱
units.en: FTZs might enable TBML by importing consignments with counterfeit or tampered paperwork and then re-exporting the goods to other countries while disguising their actual origin and nature.

units.zh: 自由贸易区为毒品、象牙、艺术品走私和人口贩运提供平台
units.en: This environment also provides a platform for illegal trades, such as drug trafficking, ivory trade, stolen artwork, and people smuggling.

units.zh: 自由贸易区执法不力便利逃税和增值税欺诈
units.en: Additionally, FTZ regulations with inadequate enforcement might facilitate tax evasion and VAT fraud by allowing criminals to obscure the actual beneficial owners of assets derived from crimes.

units.zh: 自由贸易区最初旨在吸引外资和创造就业，多位于发展中国家。
units.en: FTZs were originally set up to attract foreign direct investments and create jobs, and they are often located in developing countries.

units.zh: 截至2025年，全球约130个国家拥有约4500个自由贸易区。
units.en: According to the think tank Global Financial Integrity, approximately 4,500 FTZs exist in more than 130 countries as of 2025.

units.zh: 自由贸易区为企业节省成本、改善现金流并提升国际竞争力。
units.en: FTZs benefit companies by offering cost savings, enhancing cash flow, and boosting their competitiveness in international trade.

units.zh: 自由贸易区可降低或取消税收、关税及商业注册监管要求。
units.en: FTZs can lower or remove taxes, customs duties, and business registration regulations.

units.zh: 许多自由贸易区提供标准移民程序和外资限制的特别豁免。
units.en: Many zones globally offer special exemptions from standard immigration procedures and foreign investment restrictions, among other benefits.

units.zh: 自由贸易区旨在促进经济活动和就业
units.en: These zones aim to promote economic activity and employment that might otherwise take place elsewhere.

units.zh: 欧盟委员会指出自由贸易区对贸易体系构成新兴威胁
units.en: The European Commission has also pointed out that since FTZs are popular for storing artwork, antiquities, precious metals, and wine, and that they pose emerging threats to the integrity of the trade system.

units.zh: FATF指出的自由贸易区系统性弱点列表
units.en: According to FATF, systemic weaknesses for FTZs include:

units.zh: 自由贸易区反洗钱/反恐怖融资保障措施不足
units.en: Inadequate AML/CFT safeguards.

units.zh: 地方当局对自由贸易区监管极少
units.en: Minimal oversight by local authorities.

units.zh: 自由贸易区货物和法人检查程序薄弱，记录保存和IT系统不足
units.en: Weak procedures to inspect goods and legal entities, including inadequate recordkeeping and information technology systems.

units.zh: 自由贸易区与当地海关当局缺乏合作
units.en: Lack of cooperation between FTZs and local customs authorities.

units.zh: 监管宽松阻碍当局追踪和追回犯罪所得
units.en: This can hinder authorities and law enforcement agencies from tracing and recovering proceeds of crime due to relaxed oversight.

cp_b.reason: Central risk indicator with an enumerated list of specific TBML techniques as support.

units.zh: 列举贸易型洗钱（TB洗钱）的风险类型。
units.en: Given the complexity and global nature of trade transactions, money launderers might seek to disguise the proceeds of crime and move value using TBML to misrepresent the price, quantity, or quality of imports and exports. Risks of TBML can include:

units.zh: 贸易融资是促进跨境货物和服务流动的金融产品和服务。
units.en: Trade finance involves a range of financial products and services that facilitate the movement of goods and services across borders and ensure that exporters receive payments promptly while importers receive their goods as agreed.

units.zh: 在关联实体集团内远程交易以掩盖交易真实性质。
units.en: Trades booked remotely within a group of related entities to obscure the true nature and purpose of transactions.

units.zh: 预先安排的交易可制造虚假交易量并掩盖资金来源。
units.en: Pre-arranged trading that can create artificial trading volumes and obscure the origin of funds.

units.zh: 第三方指令或参与增加复杂性，使资金来源更难追踪。
units.en: Instructions or involvement from third parties that add layers of complexity, making it harder to trace the source of funds.

units.zh: 非标准结算安排被用于掩盖交易真实性质。
units.en: Nonstandard settlement arrangements a customer uses to disguise the true nature of transactions.

units.zh: 不经济或不合理的交易策略可能暗示洗钱风险。
units.en: Uneconomic or irrational trading strategies that do not make economic sense.

units.zh: 异常交易模式如对手方集中、异常盈亏率或中性化活动是洗钱风险信号。
units.en: Unusual trading patterns such as counterparty concentration, unusual winloss rates, or flat or neutralizing activity.

units.zh: 保理和福费廷可能被利用将非法应收账款转换为合法资金。
units.en: Factoring and forfaiting, which can be exploited to convert illicit receivables into legitimate funds.

units.zh: 供应链融资中复杂的供应链安排可能被用于掩盖非法资金来源和流向。
units.en: Supply chain financing where complex supply chain arrangements might be used to obscure the origin and flow of illicit funds.

candidates.cp_b_title_en: Case: Using Typology Reports and Public-Private Partnership to Enhance AML Controls

cp_a.reason: Units 1829–1830 provide important clarifications and factual details about the AML Authority not covered in the mandates.

units.zh: 反洗钱管理局不同于欧盟FIU，但起支持协调作用
units.en: Note that the AML Authority is not the EU FIU; rather, it plays a vital role in supporting and coordinating within the FIU's network.

units.zh: 反洗钱管理局总部设在德国法兰克福，将开始直接监管
units.en: The AML Authority is expected to commence direct supervision, with its headquarters in Frankfurt, Germany.

cp_b.title_zh: 案例：利用类型学报告和公私合作加强反洗钱控制
cp_b.title_en: Case: Using Typology Reports and Public-Private Partnership to Enhance AML Controls
cp_b.reason: This core point captures the entire case example, which demonstrates how a public-private partnership can use a typology report to detect money laundering, file SARs, and recommend control enhancements. The narrative is continuous, so it is treated as a single reviewable case study.

units.zh: 案例：执法机构发现通过加密资产和银行业洗钱增加，并利用钱骡
units.en: Law enforcement authorities in Isabella's jurisdiction have noted an increase in money laundering via cryptoassets and the banking sector. Authorities believe that criminals are recruiting individuals as money mules.

units.zh: 执法机构成立工作组，包括金融情报机构、监管机构及银行和虚拟资产行业代表
units.en: Law enforcement sets up a working group to address this trend. The group includes the FIU, regulator, and representatives of the bank and virtual assets sectors. The group's aim is to produce better intelligence to detect those involved in this activity and improve controls in the private sector.

units.zh: 执法机构发布类型学报告，揭示学生利用虚拟资产服务提供商账户和银行账户转移犯罪收益
units.en: Law enforcement issues a typology report via the group, explaining how the suspected money laundering happens. The report indicates that students open accounts with VASPs and move the proceeds of crime to and from these accounts via their local bank accounts.

units.zh: 案例：Isabella向高级管理层报告趋势，准备并提交可疑活动报告，并向工作组反馈
units.en: Isabella reports this trend to senior management, then prepares and files SARs, ensuring that the FIU knows these reports are being submitted because of the public-private partnership. She also reports her findings to the working group and confirms that their typology appears to be sound.

units.zh: 案例：Isabella向高级内部委员会提交发现和建议，包括了解你的客户和客户风险参数调整
units.en: Isabella also presents the findings to a senior internal committee along with recommendations for better protecting the organization from this activity in the future. Her recommendations include changes to the KYC and client risk profile parameters as well as adjustments to transaction monitoring processes.

units.zh: Isabella所在组织经高级管理层同意后加入工作组
units.en: Isabella's organization is invited to join the group. She obtains agreement from senior management.

units.zh: 工作组要求参与组织审查数据以确认类型学并识别匹配的客户活动
units.en: The group requests that participant organizations consider this information, review their data to confirm the typology, and identify customer activity that aligns.

units.zh: Isabella审查客户群体，确认存在大量学生账户
units.en: Isabella reviews her organization's client population and confirms a large number of student accounts.

units.zh: Isabella与数据团队合作，进一步细分学生账户群体
units.en: There are more accounts than she can review manually, so she works with the internal data team to identify ways to segment this population further.

units.zh: 案例：Isabella通过细分策略识别异常账户行为
units.en: She is able to identify accounts that are behaving unusually using this strategy.

units.zh: 案例：Isabella识别在支付备注或客户沟通中提及VASP或加密资产的账户
units.en: She also identifies accounts that mention the name of a VASP or a particular cryptoasset in payment references or via customer communication.

candidates.cp_a_title_en: Central Bank Digital Currency (CBDC): Definition and Key Rationales
candidates.cp_b_title_en: Definitions of the World Bank and International Monetary Fund

cp_a.title_zh: 央行数字货币（CBDC）：定义与主要理由
cp_a.title_en: Central Bank Digital Currency (CBDC): Definition and Key Rationales
cp_a.reason: Human review accepted this non-contiguous grouping because it forms one useful review topic in the section.

units.zh: 央行数字货币（CBDC）是由央行发行和监管的数字法定货币，具有法定货币地位
units.en: A central bank digital currency (CBDC) is a digital version of a country’s fiat currency issued and regulated by its central bank. It also functions as legal tender.

units.zh: CBDC可促进国内外更快速高效的支付系统
units.en: Payment efficiency: CBDCs can facilitate faster and more efficient payment systems both domestically and internationally compared to conventional systems.

units.zh: 发行CBDC可降低现金生产和处理成本，并减少传统清算结算系统的运营费用。
units.en: Cost reduction: The issuance of a CBDC can reduce the costs associated with physical cash production and handling. It also reduces the operational expenses related to clearing and settlement systems used in traditional banking.

units.zh: 央行可通过CBDC更直接地实施货币政策，快速应对经济变化或不稳定。
units.en: Monetary policy implementation: Central banks can influence monetary policy more directly through CBDCs by adjusting the supply and demand for digital currency. This enables the central banks to more readily respond to economic changes or manage economic instability.

units.zh: 设计良好的CBDC可为无银行账户人群提供金融服务，促进金融包容性。
units.en: Financial inclusion: A well-designed CBDC could grant access to banking services for individuals excluded from the traditional financial system, particularly in countries with underdeveloped banking infrastructure. The access makes it easier for unbanked populations to obtain basic financial services.

units.zh: CBDC可实时监控交易，提高透明度，有助于打击洗钱、逃税和恐怖融资。
units.en: Illicit activity deterrence: Unlike cash, CBDCs can be monitored in real time, providing authorities with greater transparency over transactions. This monitoring can help combat money laundering, tax evasion, and terrorist financing.

units.zh: CBDC兼具数字支付的速度便利和传统货币的稳定性
units.en: CBDCs combine the advantages of digital payments, such as speed and convenience, with the stability of traditional currencies.

units.zh: CBDC与加密货币不同，加密货币独立于政府监管
units.en: While often discussed alongside cryptocurrencies such as Bitcoin and Ethereum, CBDCs are different because cryptocurrencies operate independently of government oversight.

units.zh: 列出央行发行CBDC的原因
units.en: Central banks issue CBDCs for several reasons:

units.zh: 多个国家正在研究、试点或实施CBDC，各有不同目标和策略。
units.en: Several countries are actively researching, piloting, or already implementing CBDCs, each with distinct goals and strategies. Some examples include:

units.zh: 巴哈马的Sand Dollar是全球首个全面实施的CBDC，旨在提升金融包容性和反洗钱安全性。
units.en: The Bahamas: The Sand Dollar is the first fully implemented CBDC in the world, launched in October 2020 and available across the island for use alongside traditional cash. The initiative aims to improve financial inclusion and enhance security against money laundering and illicit activities.

units.zh: 尼日利亚的eNaira于2021年10月推出，旨在促进数字支付和金融包容性。
units.en: Nigeria: The eNaira was launched in October 2021. It facilitates digital payments, transfers, and transactions, aiming to increase financial inclusion and streamline cash management across the country.

units.zh: 牙买加的Jam-Dex于2022年5月推出，支持安全的点对点交易和支付。
units.en: Jamaica: Jamaica Digital Exchange (Jam-Dex) was launched in May 2022. It enables secure P2P transactions and payments for goods and services. It aims to reduce the costs associated with cash handling and storage.

cp_b.title_zh: 世界银行与国际货币基金组织的定义
cp_b.title_en: Definitions of the World Bank and International Monetary Fund
cp_b.reason: Basic definitions of the two organizations.

units.zh: 世界银行为发展中国家提供资金、政策和技术援助
units.en: The World Bank is an international organization that provides funding, policies, and technical assistance to developing countries.

units.zh: 国际货币基金组织（IMF）监测全球经济并维护货币体系稳定
units.en: The International Monetary Fund (IMF) keeps track of the global economy while seeking to maintain the stability of the global monetary system and lend funds to member countries.

candidates.cp_b_title_en: Periodic Review and Ongoing Due Diligence Methods

cp_a.reason: This standalone definition of EDD forms a single review point about a key onboarding AFC control.

units.zh: 强化尽职调查涉及更深入地核实财富来源和资金来源
units.en: EDD involves verifying source of wealth and source of funds more deeply, examining and verifying any claims through supporting documentation.

cp_b.title_zh: 定期审查与持续尽职调查方法
cp_b.title_en: Periodic Review and Ongoing Due Diligence Methods
cp_b.reason: All four units describe methods for periodic review and ongoing due diligence, forming a cohesive review point.

units.zh: 根据风险水平和监管要求进行定期了解你的客户更新
units.en: Scheduled KYC refreshes: Conduct mandatory data updates based on risk levels and evolving regulatory expectations.

units.zh: 根据信息或行为变化持续调整客户画像和交易限额
units.en: Continuous risk assessments: Adjust customer profiles and transaction limits based on information or behavioral shifts.

units.zh: 应用持续监控和更深入的交易审查以降低风险敞口
units.en: Ongoing risk monitoring: Apply continuous surveillance and deeper transaction scrutiny to mitigate exposure.

units.zh: 持续了解你的客户等高级流程通过持续监控数据变化触发了解你的客户更新
units.en: Dynamic risk management: Sophisticated processes, such as perpetual KYC, involve continuously monitoring data to identify changes and trigger a KYC refresh.

candidates.cp_a_title_en: Decision Process and Documentation When Not Filing a SAR
candidates.cp_b_title_en: SAFS case: AML/CFT failures due to outdated EWRA

cp_a.title_zh: 不提交SAR时的决策流程与记录
cp_a.title_en: Decision Process and Documentation When Not Filing a SAR
cp_a.reason: Core review point covering the required process and documentation steps when deciding not to file a SAR, with the introductory context as support.

units.zh: 未提交SAR时，机构仍须遵守内部程序以确保合规并降低风险
units.en: In cases where a SAR is not filed, organizations must still adhere to internal procedures to ensure compliance and mitigate risks.

units.zh: 决定不提交SAR时，金融机构必须有明确的异常活动评估流程，包括升级程序
units.en: When deciding not to file a SAR, the financial institution must have a clear process for evaluating unusual activity, including an escalation procedure.

units.zh: 详细记录不提交SAR的理由，包括活动描述、分析步骤、决策依据及支持文件
units.en: Document the rationale for not filing a SAR in detail. This includes describing the activity that prompted the review, the steps taken to analyze it, the reasoning behind the decision not to file, and any supporting documents, such as transaction records or memos. This documentation will allow regulators to understand the decision.

units.zh: 报告可疑活动对有效的金融犯罪防控（金融犯罪防控）计划至关重要
units.en: Reporting suspicious activity is critical for an effective AFC program.

cp_b.title_zh: SAFS案例：因未更新企业风险评估而导致的反洗钱/反恐怖融资失败
cp_b.title_en: SAFS case: AML/CFT failures due to outdated EWRA
cp_b.reason: Human review accepted the P2A boundary after checking the section-level review topic.

units.zh: 新加坡金管局因SAFS未更新企业级风险评估而处以250万新元罚款
units.en: The Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS) took enforcement action against Swiss-Asia Financial Services Pte Ltd (SAFS), imposing a S$2.5 million penalty for AML/CFT violations. The wealth and fund management firm failed to update its enterprise-wide risk assessment (EWRA), despite rapid business expansion over a three-year period. This exposed SAFS to new and increased risks of financial crime.

units.zh: SAFS未更新企业级风险评估，静态风险模型导致未检测的金融犯罪风险
units.en: Failure to conduct EWRA updates: SAFS did not reassess its risk framework despite a significant increase in assets under management and onboarding of high-risk clients. A static risk model exposed the firm to undetected financial crime risks.

units.zh: SAFS客户尽职调查控制薄弱，未对高风险客户进行强化尽职调查
units.en: Weak customer due diligence controls: The firm onboarded high-risk customers without conducting enhanced due diligence, failing to verify sources of wealth or screen ultimate beneficial owners against watchlists.

units.zh: 交易监控系统缺乏风险分层，导致漏报可疑交易和延迟提交可疑交易报告
units.en: Inadequate transaction monitoring controls: The firm’s transaction monitoring system lacked risk segmentation and failed to flag suspicious transactions, leading to missed red flags and delayed suspicious activity reports.

units.zh: 高级管理层未能确保反洗钱/反恐怖融资控制措施跟上业务扩张步伐
units.en: Management oversight failures: Senior management failed to ensure that AML/CFT controls kept pace with business expansion. The firm lacked riskbased governance and experienced internal audit failures.

units.zh: MAS发现的反洗钱/反恐怖融资违规行为列表
units.en: MAS uncovered the following AML/CFT breaches:

units.zh: 违规行为对公司及其管理人员产生负面影响
units.en: The breaches had a negative impact on the firm’s business and its managers.

units.zh: 新加坡金融管理局除罚款外还要求公司加强反洗钱合规计划并开展独立风险审查
units.en: For example, in addition to imposing the S$2.5 million fine, MAS required the firm to enhance its AML compliance program and conduct independent risk reviews.

units.zh: 声誉损害导致客户撤资和投资者担忧，影响收入和业务增长
units.en: The resulting reputational damage caused client withdrawals and investor concerns, which impacted revenue and business growth.

units.zh: 高级管理层受到正式训诫，强调高管在反洗钱/反恐怖融资监督中的问责制
units.en: Senior management was officially reprimanded, highlighting the need for executive accountability in AML/CFT oversight.

units.zh: 常见法国名字与欧盟制裁名单匹配产生误报
units.en: Marie also identifies that during the screening process, one specific common French name keeps matching against the European sanctions list, generating false positives that analysts must address.

units.zh: 系统在姓名与观察名单略有差异时遗漏匹配
units.en: Similarly, the system seems to be missing matches when the name is slightly different from its appearance on watch lists.

units.zh: 系统使用部分匹配逻辑且不允许姓名偏差
units.en: After further investigation, she notes that the system uses partial match logic to identify possible hits and does not allow deviations in names.

units.zh: 误报示例：'Henri'与名单上的'Henrik'匹配
units.en: The system keeps matching “Henri” against “Henrik,” which is indicated on the list.

cp_b.title_zh: 选择批量筛查技术的关键考虑因素
cp_b.title_en: Key Considerations for Selecting Batch Screening Technology
cp_b.reason: The entire section is a case example that illustrates the key criteria for evaluating batch screening technology, forming a single review point.

units.zh: 系统使用何种技术？
units.en: What kind of technology is the system using?

units.zh: OFAC和联合国宣布新制裁实体后，系统多久更新？
units.en: How soon does the system update after OFAC and the UN announce new sanctioned entities?

units.zh: 系统如何检索客户数据？
units.en: How does the system work to retrieve customer data?

units.zh: 如何调整模糊逻辑设置以优化拉丁、阿拉伯和西里尔字母的性能？
units.en: How can the organization adjust fuzzy logic settings to perform optimally for Latin, Arabic, and Cyrillic alphabets? Given that the organization plans to expand geographically, what is the performance for other alphabet sets?

units.zh: 系统如何生成警报？
units.en: How does the system generate alerts?

units.zh: 评估批量筛查系统时需关注其使用的AI技术及结果可解释性
units.en: What AI technologies does the system use? How can their results be explained?

units.zh: 评估批量筛查系统时需关注其处理大量数据时的稳定性、性能和响应时间
units.en: What are the system's stability, performance, and response time like when handling a large amount of data?

units.zh: 评估批量筛查系统时需关注其如何提供审计追踪
units.en: How does the system provide an audit trail?

units.zh: Marco评估批量筛查系统的标准包括可解释性、集成便利性、可扩展性和灵活性
units.en: Marco focuses his assessment on the explainability and ease of integration of each system to ensure seamless compatibility with existing infrastructure, including core banking and case management systems. He also assesses its ability to scale with growing transaction and customer volumes. Finally, he evaluates the flexibility of system settings and tuning to ensure the selected system can perform the job for multiple jurisdictions.

units.zh: 合规官Marco考虑采用新的批量筛查技术，以提升金融犯罪防控效率并减少误报。
units.en: Marco, a compliance officer at an international financial institution, is considering new batch screening technologies from different vendors. His goal is to enhance AFC efficiency and reduce false positive alerts and manual workloads. Marco believes new technologies could streamline the organization’s resources and enhance control effectiveness.

units.zh: Marco评估当前筛查系统的差距。
units.en: Marco performs an assessment to identify gaps in the current screening system.

units.zh: 当前系统在模糊逻辑匹配方面存在局限。
units.en: He notes that the current system has limitations in fuzzy logic matching.

units.zh: 系统无法一致处理不同语言。
units.en: In addition, the system cannot handle different languages consistently.

units.zh: 系统对姓名中含“Muhammad”的客户产生大量误报。
units.en: Therefore, the system generates a large volume of false positive alerts on customers with “Muhammad” in their name.

units.zh: 多家供应商向Marco演示系统，Marco准备了一系列问题。
units.en: Various vendors approach Marco to demonstrate their systems, some of which use AI to enhance fuzzy logic. Marco prepares a list of questions for the vendors, including the following:

units.zh: Marco准备向董事会提议批量筛查方案以提升合规效率和控制有效性
units.en: By carefully considering these factors, Marco will be prepared to propose a batch screening solution to the board and persuade them that investing in it will enhance compliance efficiency and improve control effectiveness.

candidates.cp_b_title_en: Key integration factors for screening systems

cp_a.reason: The four processes (extract, clean/transform, integrate, aggregate) form a single review point about data preparation steps.

units.zh: 从源系统提取数据。
units.en: Extract data from source systems.

units.zh: 清洗和转换数据以供多个系统使用。
units.en: Clean and transform data for use by multiple systems.

units.zh: 通过合并多个来源来整合数据。
units.en: Integrate data by combining multiple sources.

units.zh: 聚合数据以利用数据协同效应。
units.en: Aggregate data to benefit from data synergies.

units.zh: 数据准备的四个关键过程。
units.en: There are four key processes for data preparation:

cp_b.title_zh: 筛查系统集成的关键考虑因素
cp_b.title_en: Key integration factors for screening systems
cp_b.reason: Groups the five prescriptive rules that collectively outline essential integration considerations: compatibility, assessment, vendor selection, data security, and regulatory compliance.

units.zh: 筛查系统应与其他系统兼容，包括数据流、工作流和API集成
units.en: Screening systems should be compatible with other systems. This includes data flows, workflow management tools, and application programming interface (API) integrations.

units.zh: 全面评估所有系统接触点并理解筛查工作流有助于成功实施
units.en: Carrying out a complete assessment of all touchpoints with other systems and understanding the screening process workflow enables a more successful implementation later.

units.zh: 使用软件供应商时应选择提供可靠支持和定期更新的供应商
units.en: When using software vendors instead of building systems in-house, organizations should also choose providers that offer reliable support and regular updates. Implementing controls for ongoing maintenance and troubleshooting is also essential to ensure system efficiency.

units.zh: 集成过程中应特别关注数据安全和隐私，遵守《通用数据保护条例》等法规
units.en: Organizations should also pay special attention to data security and privacy during integration. They should ensure compliance with all relevant data protection regulations, such as the GDPR in Europe. Organizations should implement strong encryption methods to protect sensitive data and restrict access to authorized individuals.

units.zh: 确保最终集成系统符合所有金融犯罪系统的监管要求
units.en: Likewise, organizations should ensure that the final integrated system complies with all regulatory requirements and guidelines for financial crime systems.

units.zh: 金融犯罪和技术不断演变，机构日益需要整合系统以应对风险
units.en: With the evolving and dynamic landscape of financial crime and technology, organizations increasingly need to integrate their systems to address risks, enhance agility, improve security, and ensure compliance.

units.zh: 将筛查系统与其他系统集成时需考虑多个因素
units.en: When integrating screening systems with other systems or databases, such as transaction monitoring systems, organizations should consider several factors.

units.zh: 开户时按需逐个筛查灵活，批量筛查可提高效率
units.en: During onboarding, organizations often need to screen customers individually rather than in batches. Although screening customers one by one on an asneeded basis offers flexibility, screening customers in batches can improve efficiency.

units.zh: 金融犯罪防控技术不断演进，不同系统功能趋于融合，云方案提供更多集成可能
units.en: As AFC technologies evolve, the capabilities of different systems are likely to converge. For example, technologies such as cloud-based solutions offer more possibilities for integrating systems, such as payment screening systems with real-time monitoring.
